extracted.name: Ahi Shoyu Poke
extracted.description: Make Hawaiian shoyu poke at home with this easy recipe that combines fresh tuna, soy sauce, onion, ginger, and sesame oil for a quick, flavorful appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound fresh ahi steaks, cut into small cubes
2 teaspoons finely chopped toasted macadamia nuts
instruction_lines: Combine ahi cubes, soy sauce, Maui onion, green onion, chile pepper, sesame oil, sesame seeds, macadamia nuts, ginger, and sea salt in a large bowl. Gently toss to combine.
